basis: Autoimmune skin and muscle disease; dysphagia (~40-60%) reflects swallowing-muscle myopathy. ILD is generally below 30% in this subtype.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: common dysphagia reflects swallowing-muscle weakness; common direct gastrointestinal tissue damage is not established.

basis: Defining gonadal failure; hypogonadism occurs in 80-99%. Hypospadias and urogenital sinus malformations directly affect the urinary outlet in 30-79%.

decisions.renal: involved: hypospadias and urogenital sinus anomalies are structural urethral abnormalities, each reported in 30-79%; the renal axis includes the urethra.

basis: Encephalocele and polydactyly 5/5; cystic renal dysplasia 2/5. Hepatic ductal-plate malformation/fibrosis affects most Meckel cases; TCTN2-specific frequency is unavailable.

decisions.hepatic: involved: hepatic ductal-plate malformation with fibrosis is a core Meckel manifestation affecting most cases (>30%); subtype-specific frequency is unreported.

basis: Motor-neuron disease with intellectual disability; sustained denervation causes actual skeletal-muscle wasting in most patients, integral to the syndrome.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: persistent neurogenic muscle atrophy affects most patients; structural muscle wasting is integral to this disease, beyond weakness alone.

basis: Pentose phosphate defect with defining cirrhosis and cytopenias (80-99%); renal abnormalities 30-79%. Skin changes omitted at cap; individual cardiac defects occur in <30%.

decisions.haematologic: primary: anemia and thrombocytopenia are explicit defining manifestations, each present in 80-99%; they establish disease of blood cells.

basis: Inherited cystic renal disease; kidney failure in 13/14. Hypertension (16/20) is separately diagnosed; secondary ventricular hypertrophy does not establish direct cardiac disease. Liver cysts 10%.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: hypertension (16/20) is a separately diagnosed renal consequence; ventricular hypertrophy (2/2) does not establish direct cardiovascular involvement.

basis: Lysosomal disease with defining immunodeficiency and intellectual disability (80-99%); dysostosis multiplex 80-99%. Hearing impairment and cataracts (30-79%) omitted at cap.

decisions.neurologic: primary: intellectual disability and developmental impairment are defining features of infantile alpha-mannosidosis, with intellectual disability reported in 80-99%.

basis: Inherited phagocyte oxidative-burst defect; intrinsic granulomatous bowel inflammation affects roughly 30-50%, especially X-linked disease. Secondary organ infections are separate diagnoses.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: intrinsic granulomatous enterocolitis affects approximately 30-50%; it reflects CGD inflammatory dysfunction rather than coincidental inflammatory bowel disease.

basis: Defined by osteosarcoma, limb malformations and erythroid macrocytosis. Caries is reported in 80-99%, but direct syndromic dental damage is not established.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: caries frequency (80-99%) alone does not establish direct dental involvement; caries is a separate disease without demonstrated intrinsic dental pathology here.

basis: Inherited peripheral axonal and demyelinating neuropathy; sustained denervation causes characteristic structural skeletal-muscle atrophy in most patients.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: chronic neurogenic muscle wasting affects most patients (>30%); actual structural atrophy is integral to the neuropathy, beyond weakness alone.
